rules.msg: WEB Auth brute-force - high POST rate to login endpoint from one source [medium]
rules.raw: alert http any any -> any any (msg:"WEB Auth brute-force - high POST rate to login endpoint from one source [medium]"; flow:established,to_server; http.method; content:"POST"; http.uri; content:"login"; nocase; fast_pattern; threshold:type threshold, track by_src, count 20, seconds 60; classtype:attempted-recon; metadata: asset_category web-mixed, owasp A07-Identification-and-Authentication-Failures, attack_target Server, mitre_tactic_id TA0006, mitre_tactic_name Credential-Access, mitre_technique_id T1110, mitre_technique_name Brute-Force, kill_chain Exploitation, confidence medium, signature_severity Major, deployment Perimeter, network_mode plain, cve none, poc_ref tests/poc/9180001_http-login-flood/poc.sh, tag auth-bruteforce, created_at 2026_05_19, updated_at 2026_05_19, author huntingyuk; sid:9180001; rev:1;)

description.attack: Brute-force / credential-stuffing: penyerang membombardir endpoint login dengan banyak percobaan password dari satu sumber.
description.impact: Akun bisa jebol kalau ada password lemah/bocor; bisa juga jadi DoS ke layanan auth.
description.detects: Laju POST yang tinggi ke endpoint berisi 'login' dari satu IP (threshold 20/60 detik) — body gagal-login tidak selalu terlihat jadi volume yang jadi sinyal.

description.attack: Penyerang spray kombinasi `username:password` lewat header `Authorization: Basic` ke endpoint berproteksi (login HTTP Basic) — varian credential-stuffing yang nggak lewat form login.
description.impact: Akun jebol kalau ada password lemah/bocor; bisa juga DoS layanan auth.
description.detects: Laju header `Authorization: Basic` tinggi dari satu IP (threshold 30/60 detik) — sibling 9180001 (POST login form).
